programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When Scott Dunn goes missing, police spray his bedroom with Luminol and uncover a scene of horrific violence. Now investigators face a daunting task: proving that Scott Dunn had been murdered without a body, a witness or a murder weapon.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Alexander The Great'. What if Alexander had not died at the age of 32? What if he had listened to advisors and returned to Macedonia instead of going on his worldwide conquest?

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Race To The Moon'. What is the future of the human presence in space? How might things be different if there had not been a Cold War and a Space Race?

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Christophe Rocancourt'. From an orphanage in a small town in France to the heart of the glitterati of Los Angeles and New York, Christophe Thierry Rocancourt is a legend on the imposter scene.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Matthew Cox'. Matthew Cox is an American former mortgage broker from Florida who made millions falsifying documents to make it appear that he owned the properties.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Jan Lewan'. Jan Lewandowski, known as Jan Lewan, is a Polish-American songwriter and polka band leader. Lewan's financial crimes were described as a 'classic Ponzi scheme'.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Frdric Bourdin'. Frdric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter the press has nicknamed 'The Chameleon'.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Shaun Greenhalgh'. Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger. Over a seventeen-year period, between 1989 and 2006, he produced a large number of forgeries in a variety of styles.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Helmut Kiener'. One of Germany's greatest con artists, Helmut Kiener tricked thousands of private investors and banks out of more than $300 million.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Lightning'. Nigel tests conductivity by putting electricity through a small child, we see what kind of destruction a whole lot of amps can do.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Explosions'. What's the difference between movie explosions and real explosions? Nigel blows stuff up to find out.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Weather'. In this episode, Nigel looks at the Science of Extreme Weather. Does a hat really make a difference in the freezing cold?

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Collisions'. In this episode, Nigel crashes a small, modern car into a large, heavy, old car to find out which one you and your family would be better off in.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Fire'. Nigel shows us the science of exactly what it takes to start a fire and experiences firsthand what it's like to be inside a burning house...by burning down a house.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Space'. Nigel's mission: To explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations to boldly go where no television presenter, has gone before.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Sound'. In this episode, Nigel tries to break the sound barrier and ends up breaking all kinds of other stuff along the way.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Gravity'. In this episode, Nigel takes on Galileo and tests the Law of Gravity by jumping out of a perfectly good plane with an orange to see which will hit the ground first.

programme.desc: Beneath the frozen Arctic lies green ice teeming with life. Explore how this algae-rich layer fuels entire ecosystems in a rapidly changing climate.

programme.desc: While a royal guard pursues an evil rapist, they are accidentally frozen. Thawed out to modern-day Hong Kong, the pursuit to uphold justice continues.

programme.desc: The Hong Kong police deploys undercover agents to dismantle a triad syndicate. Betrayal and murder erupt in violent confrontations between the 'brothers' and the law.

programme.desc: A taxi driver who judges others by his own standards sets out to help 'victims' in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he tries to help her.

programme.desc: An undercover cop framed for murder is forced to take a coroner hostage so as to prove his innocence in the murder of his partner.

programme.desc: To save the loyal General Yue Fei from a deadly plot, Miao Lung leads patriots to intercept twelve gold medallions carrying a corrupt chancellor's execution order.

programme.desc: A labourer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich, but has to use his kung fu skills to survive, as well as to take revenge against the gang who killed his brother.

programme.title: Guns & Roses
programme.desc: Jin Shui risks everything to save his family, fleeing France with the help of his friend. Amid challenges, Jin Shui faces a dilemma: love or loyalty to his friend.

programme.title: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Constable Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yu Tong. Unbeknownst to Zhan, Bai is a girl subtly vying for his heart amidst their escalating conflicts.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: A team of skilled fighters navigate a house rigged with an array of ingenious and deadly traps.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: 3AM The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital discovers her husband's affair and encounters another victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit?

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: A Vietnam vet who's now an 'honourable' mercenary-for-hire taking on an assignment tracking down an assassin who's fled to Cambodia after murdering an industrialist from Hong Kong.

programme.title: Once A Gangster

programme.desc: A psychotic younger brother is driven to avenge his older brother's death.
